title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1968-08-22
lineage: SBD > MR > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy August ’68 show with a smoking Alligator > Caution jam and stellar Dark Star, captured in surprisingly clear stereo soundboard mix despite some mono sections and minor glitches.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers an exciting snapshot of the Dead’s late‑summer 1968 peak – tight, fiery jams on Alligator>Caution, The Eleven, Dark Star and The Other One dominate, with Jerry’s soaring guitar tone and Phil’s aggressive bass driving the momentum. Technically the source is a mixed matrix (soundboard‑derived stereo for the second set and mono for the early songs) that sounds remarkably clean for its era, though a few cuts and clipping on St Stephen are noted.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.6/5 across 19 reviews; comments consistently praise the musical performance and overall sound quality, with only minor technical complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Second set in clear stereo; first‑set material largely mono (likely radio feed). Reviewers note occasional clipping on St Stephen and brief drop‑outs, but overall crisp, balanced mix with excellent guitar/organ presence.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early set a bit rough and missing tracks, but gains momentum quickly; second set flows superbly with seamless transitions from Alligator into drums, Caution and the climactic jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Endless runs, perfect 68‑tone guitar, strong vocals on Death Don't and The Eleven, leading many jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Aggressive, funky bass lines; duels with Jerry in The Eleven; extended solo on New Potato; drives the intensity of Alligator>Caution.
band_member_comments.Keys: Organ embellishments praised on Death Don't; tight keyboard work throughout the jam sections.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's drums ‘going nuts’, notable drum solo during Alligator, tight and propulsive rhythm section.
